title: Chain of Liberation

sources.title: Sprint (passive feature)
markers: | description = Once per turn, the wearer can reduce the duration of their {{Cond|Momentum}} by 1 turn to {{SAI|Sprint}}.

sources.title: Momentum
markers: per remaining duration of this effect

summary: Medium armour with base AC 13 plus up to +2 from Dexterity. Once per turn, spend one turn of Momentum to Sprint without provoking opportunity attacks.

fields.Sprint: Once per turn, move 20 ft in a straight line without provoking opportunity attacks. Requires Momentum and spends one turn of it.
fields.Availability: Unobtainable in normal play. Early Access item replaced by Luminous Armour.
fields.Base value: 480 gp in BG3. Merchant prices vary.
fields.Momentum: Gain 5 ft of movement speed for each remaining turn of Momentum, up to 5 turns.

changes: Added native BG3 gameplay use and reviewed pinned source evidence. Expanded the card from the pinned item and linked gameplay evidence.
